description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ImagePreview' used for displaying images with zoom capabilities, including controls for adjusting the zoom level and embedded styling based on context. It imports external icon types and styling utilities, manages internal state for image dimensions and zoom levels, and uses effect hooks to load image data and synchronize zoom level props.

methods.name: useCallback
methods.description: Creates a memoized callback function to set the image zoom level, ensuring it doesn't change unnecessarily and depends on 'setImageZoomLevel' prop.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Used twice: first to update 'imageZoomPercent' when 'imageZoomLevel' prop changes; second to load an image from 'objectUrl' and set 'imageWidth' and 'imageHeight'.
